+    promoted_ids: set[str] = set()
+    for instance in candidate_instances:
+        instance_id = instance["procedure_instance_id"]
+        model = models.get(instance["procedure_model_ref"])
+        require(instance["role"] == "supporting", f"candidate is not supporting: {instance_id}")
+        require(model is not None, f"candidate ProcedureModel is not active: {instance_id}")
+        require(
+            instance["qp_evidence_anchor_refs"] and instance["ms_evidence_anchor_refs"],
+            f"candidate lacks exact QP/MS evidence: {instance_id}",
+        )
+        owning_family = types[model["question_type_id"]]["question_family_id"]
+        declared_owner = instance.get("foreign_family_owner_ref")
+        require(
+            declared_owner in {None, owning_family},
+            f"candidate owning-family conflict: {instance_id}",
+        )
+        require(
+            owning_family not in primary_by_part.get(instance["question_part_id"], set()),
+            f"supporting candidate conflicts with same-family primary ownership: {instance_id}",
+        )
+        instance["status"] = "approved"
+        instance["reconciliation_ref"] = f"issue-{ISSUE}:supporting-candidate-resolution"
+        promoted_ids.add(instance_id)
+        transitions.append(
+            {
+                "branch_key": instance["branch_key"],
+                "evidence_preserved": {
+                    "ms_evidence_anchor_refs": instance["ms_evidence_anchor_refs"],
+                    "qp_evidence_anchor_refs": instance["qp_evidence_anchor_refs"],
+                },
+                "from_status": "candidate",
+                "owning_question_family_ref": owning_family,
+                "procedure_instance_id": instance_id,
+                "procedure_model_ref": instance["procedure_model_ref"],
+                "question_id": instance["question_id"],
+                "question_part_id": instance["question_part_id"],
+                "reason": "exact-evidence supporting application resolved against the active owning ProcedureModel",
+                "role": "supporting",
+                "sequence_index": instance["sequence_index"],
+                "to_status": "approved",
+            }
+        )
+
+    for node in next_nodes["nodes"]:
+        if node["node_id"] in promoted_ids:
+            require(node["node_type"] == "ProcedureInstance", "promoted node type drift")
+            require(node["status"] == "candidate", "promoted node status drift")
+            node["status"] = "approved"
+            node["reconciliation_ref"] = f"issue-{ISSUE}:supporting-candidate-resolution"
+    for edge in next_edges["edges"]:
+        if edge["from_node_id"] in promoted_ids or edge["to_node_id"] in promoted_ids:
+            require(edge["status"] == "candidate", f"candidate edge status drift: {edge['edge_id']}")
+            edge["status"] = "approved"
+
+    next_nodes["issue"] = ISSUE
+    next_edges["issue"] = ISSUE
+    next_composition["issue"] = ISSUE
+    instances = next_composition["procedure_instances"]
+    family_candidate_fields = (
+        "complex_numbers_supporting_candidate_count",
+        "differential_equations_supporting_candidate_count",
+        "differentiation_supporting_candidate_count",
+        "trigonometry_supporting_candidate_count",
+        "logarithmic_exponential_supporting_candidate_count",
+        "numerical_solution_supporting_candidate_count",
+    )
+    promoted_by_family = {
+        field.replace("_candidate_count", "_reconciled_instance_count"):
+            next_composition["summary"][field]
+        for field in family_candidate_fields
+    }
+    require(
+        sum(promoted_by_family.values())
+        == EXPECTED_PROMOTED_SUPPORTING_INSTANCE_COUNT,
+        "per-family candidate counters do not conserve final promotions",
+    )
+    next_composition["summary"] = {
+        **next_composition["summary"],
+        **{field: 0 for field in family_candidate_fields},
+        **promoted_by_family,
+        "approved_procedure_instance_count": sum(item["status"] == "approved" for item in instances),
+        "candidate_procedure_instance_count": sum(item["status"] == "candidate" for item in instances),
+        "final_reconciled_supporting_instance_count": len(transitions),
+    }
+    return next_nodes, next_edges, next_composition, sorted(
+        transitions, key=lambda item: item["procedure_instance_id"]
+    )
+
+
+def build_terminal_ledger(
+    repo: Path,
+    nodes: dict[str, Any],
+    edges: dict[str, Any],
+    registry: dict[str, Any],
+    composition: dict[str, Any],
+    transitions: list[dict[str, Any]],
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
+    node_index, evidence_by_owner = evidence_indexes(nodes, edges)
+    questions = sorted(
+        (
+            node for node in nodes["nodes"]
+            if node["node_type"] == "Question"
+            and P3_PAPER_PATTERN.search(node["paper_id"])
+        ),
+        key=lambda item: item["node_id"],
+    )
+    question_ids = {item["node_id"] for item in questions}
+    parts = sorted(
+        (
+            node for node in nodes["nodes"]
+            if node["node_type"] == "QuestionPart"
+            and node["question_id"] in question_ids
+        ),
+        key=lambda item: item["node_id"],
+    )
+    require(len(questions) == EXPECTED_P3_QUESTION_COUNT, "Paper 3 Question count drift")
+    require(len(parts) == EXPECTED_P3_PART_COUNT, "Paper 3 QuestionPart count drift")
+    require(
+        sum(part["role"] == "score_owning" for part in parts)
+        == EXPECTED_P3_SCORE_OWNING_PART_COUNT,
+        "Paper 3 score-owning part count drift",
+    )
+    require(
+        sum(part["role"] == "instruction_only" for part in parts)
+        == EXPECTED_P3_INSTRUCTION_ONLY_PART_COUNT,
+        "Paper 3 instruction-only part count drift",
+    )
+
+    registry_by_question = {record["question_id"]: record for record in registry["records"]}
+    direct = direct_child_decisions(repo)
+    integration = integration_candidate_decisions(repo)
+    promoted_by_part: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for transition in transitions:
+        promoted_by_part[transition["question_part_id"]].append(transition)
+    instances_by_part: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for instance in composition["procedure_instances"]:
+        instances_by_part[instance["question_part_id"]].append(instance)
+    approved_classifications: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for edge in edges["edges"]:
+        if edge["edge_type"] == "PART_CLASSIFIED_AS" and edge["status"] == "approved":
+            approved_classifications[edge["from_node_id"]].append(edge["to_node_id"])
+
+    originally_covered: set[str] = set()
+    for part_id in direct:
+        originally_covered.add(part_id)
+    for part_id, decisions in integration.items():
+        if any(item.get("selected_question_part_id") == part_id for item in decisions):
+            originally_covered.add(part_id)
+    originally_covered.update(approved_classifications)
+    originally_covered.update(instances_by_part)
+    previously_uncovered = {
+        part["node_id"] for part in parts
+        if part["role"] == "score_owning" and part["node_id"] not in originally_covered
+    }
+    require(
+        len(previously_uncovered) == EXPECTED_PREVIOUSLY_UNCOVERED_SCORE_PART_COUNT,
+        "previously uncovered score-owning part count drift",
+    )
+
+    missing_questions = [item for item in questions if item["node_id"] not in registry_by_question]
+    require(
+        len(missing_questions) == EXPECTED_EXPLICITLY_UNENRICHED_QUESTION_COUNT,
+        "explicitly unenriched Question count drift",
+    )
+    question_entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for question in questions:
+        record = registry_by_question.get(question["node_id"])
+        status = record["status"] if record else "unenriched"
+        require(status in TERMINAL_STATUSES, f"invalid Question terminal status: {question['node_id']}")
+        question_entries.append(
+            {
+                "paper_id": question["paper_id"],
+                "question_id": question["node_id"],
+                "reason": (
+                    "preserved terminal semantic-registry disposition"
+                    if record else
+                    "structurally verified Paper 3 Question was not admitted by a child semantic shard"
+                ),
+                "semantic_record_ref": question["node_id"] if record else None,
+                "terminal_disposition": status,
+            }
+        )
+
+    part_entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for part in parts:
+        part_id = part["node_id"]
+        question_record = registry_by_question.get(part["question_id"])
+        refs = evidence_by_owner.get(part_id, {"qp": [], "ms": []})
+        exact_refs = {
+            "ms_evidence_anchor_refs": refs["ms"],
+            "qp_evidence_anchor_refs": refs["qp"],
+        }
+        direct_decision = direct.get(part_id)
+        integration_decisions = integration.get(part_id, [])
+        promoted = promoted_by_part.get(part_id, [])
+        classifications = sorted(set(approved_classifications.get(part_id, [])))
+        active_instances = sorted(
+            instances_by_part.get(part_id, []),
+            key=lambda item: (item["branch_key"], item["sequence_index"], item["procedure_instance_id"]),
+        )
+        sources: list[str] = []
+        classification_status = "unenriched"
+        composition_status = "not_applicable"
+        reason = "no child semantic decision admitted for this score-owning part"
+
+        if part["role"] == "instruction_only":
+            status = "unenriched"
+            reason = "instruction-only structural owner; semantic classification is not applicable"
+        elif direct_decision:
+            sources.append(direct_decision["source_artifact_ref"])
+            disposition = direct_decision["disposition"]
+            if disposition == "approved_primary":
+                status = "approved"
+                classification_status = "approved"
+                reason = "preserved reviewed child primary classification"
+            elif disposition == "rejected_incidental_operation":
+                status = "rejected"
+                classification_status = "rejected"
+                reason = "reviewed incidental operation remains rejected as a semantic procedure"
+            else:
+                classification_status = "candidate"
+                if promoted:
+                    status = "approved"
+                    composition_status = "approved"
+                    reason = "candidate classification remains isolated; exact supporting application was approved in final reconciliation"
+                else:
+                    status = "candidate"
+                    composition_status = "candidate"
+                    reason = "unmodeled or unresolved foreign-family candidate remains fail-closed"
+                decision_refs = direct_decision["exact_part_evidence_refs"]
+                require(
+                    decision_refs["qp_evidence_anchor_refs"]
+                    and decision_refs["ms_evidence_anchor_refs"],
+                    f"candidate decision lacks exact evidence: {part_id}",
+                )
+        elif integration_decisions:
+            sources.append(str(OUTPUT_RELATIVE / "part-ownership-decisions.json"))
+            selected = [
+                item for item in integration_decisions
+                if item.get("selected_question_part_id") == part_id
+            ]
+            if selected and any(item["semantic_status"] == "approved" for item in selected):
+                status = "approved"
+                classification_status = "approved"
+                reason = "preserved reviewed Integration QuestionPart ownership"
+            else:
+                status = "candidate"
+                classification_status = "candidate"
+                reason = "Integration ownership cannot be assigned to one exact score-owning part without inference"
+        elif classifications or any(item["status"] == "approved" for item in active_instances):
+            status = "approved"
+            classification_status = "approved" if classifications else "unenriched"
+            composition_status = (
+                "approved"
+                if any(item["status"] == "approved" for item in active_instances)
+                else "not_applicable"
+            )
+            reason = "preserved approved active semantic projection"
+        elif question_record and question_record["status"] in {"candidate", "abstain", "rejected"}:
+            status = question_record["status"]
+            classification_status = status
+            reason = "inherited terminal Question disposition without inventing part semantics"
+        else:
+            status = "unenriched"
+            reason = "explicit coverage gap; no reviewed part semantic authority"
+
+        if active_instances and composition_status == "not_applicable":
+            if any(item["status"] == "approved" for item in active_instances):
+                composition_status = "approved"
+            elif any(item["status"] == "candidate" for item in active_instances):
+                composition_status = "candidate"
+            elif all(item["status"] == "rejected" for item in active_instances):
+                composition_status = "rejected"
+        require(status in TERMINAL_STATUSES, f"invalid part terminal status: {part_id}")
+        if part["role"] == "score_owning":
+            require(refs["qp"] and refs["ms"], f"score-owning part lacks exact QP/MS evidence: {part_id}")
+        part_entries.append(
+            {
+                "classification_status": classification_status,
+                "composition_status": composition_status,
+                "exact_part_evidence_refs": exact_refs,
+                "owner_path": part["owner_path"],
+                "previously_uncovered": part_id in previously_uncovered,
+                "procedure_instance_refs": [item["procedure_instance_id"] for item in active_instances],
+                "question_id": part["question_id"],
+                "question_part_id": part_id,
+                "reason": reason,
+                "role": part["role"],
+                "source_decision_refs": sorted(set(sources)),
+                "terminal_disposition": status,
+            }
+        )
+
+    ledger = {
+        "active_paper_scope": "9709:paper:p3",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "question_dispositions": question_entries,
+        "question_part_dispositions": part_entries,
+        "schema_version": "9709_p3_terminal_dispositions_v1",
+        "summary": {
+            "instruction_only_question_part_count": EXPECTED_P3_INSTRUCTION_ONLY_PART_COUNT,
+            "previously_uncovered_score_owning_part_count": len(previously_uncovered),
+            "question_count": len(question_entries),
+            "question_dispositions": dict(sorted(Counter(
+                item["terminal_disposition"] for item in question_entries
+            ).items())),
+            "question_part_count": len(part_entries),
+            "question_part_dispositions": dict(sorted(Counter(
+                item["terminal_disposition"] for item in part_entries
+            ).items())),
+            "score_owning_question_part_count": EXPECTED_P3_SCORE_OWNING_PART_COUNT,
+        },
+    }
+    require(
+        ledger["summary"]["question_dispositions"]
+        == EXPECTED_P3_QUESTION_STATUS_COUNTS,
+        "Paper 3 Question terminal status distribution drift",
+    )
+    return ledger, missing_questions
+
+
+def extend_registry(
+    helper: Any,
+    base: dict[str, Any],
+    missing_questions: list[dict[str, Any]],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result = deepcopy(base)
+    existing = {record["question_id"] for record in result["records"]}
+    for question in missing_questions:
+        question_id = question["node_id"]
+        require(question_id not in existing, f"unenriched record collision: {question_id}")
+        record = {
+            "classification_bindings": [],
+            "classification_scope": "explicitly_unenriched_under_parent_contract",
+            "evidence_refs": {"question_ref": question_id},
+            "part_ownership_decision_refs": [],
+            "primary_question_type": None,
+            "procedure_instance_refs": [],
+            "question_id": question_id,
+            "review_rationale": "Structurally verified Paper 3 Question was not admitted by a child semantic shard; no semantics inferred at closeout.",
+            "reviewed_question_part_refs": [],
+            "secondary_question_types": [],
+            "status": "unenriched",
+            "unresolved_part_ownership_decision_refs": [],
+            "variant_tags": ["explicit_coverage_gap"],
+        }
+        record["semantic_record_sha256"] = helper.sha256_bytes(helper.canonical_bytes(record))

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Hash new registry records with the established encoding**

For all 26 newly added `unenriched` records, this computes `semantic_record_sha256` from `canonical_bytes()`, which is indented JSON with a trailing newline, while every existing registry record and the predecessor builders use the compact, sorted encoding from `compact_bytes()`. As a result, all 26 hashes fail the established per-record digest recomputation even though the other 929 records pass, breaking record-level custody for precisely the new coverage entries. Compute these hashes with `helper.compact_bytes(record)` instead.
